customManagers.description: Tekton pipeline and task images pinned as version@digest in .tekton manifests. The redhat-user-workloads refs are not matched: they carry {{revision}} tags and are this repo's own build outputs.
uv version pinned in the Containerfile builder stage. Containerfile.hermetic is generated and git-ignored, so only Containerfile is managed.
pybuild-deps version pinned in the Makefile; it generates requirements-build.txt from requirements.txt.

packageRules.description: Separate Python lockfile maintenance into its own branch and PR so it does not collide with other maintenance branches
prBodyNotes: After merging, run `make sync-requirements` to re-export requirements.txt and requirements-build.txt from the refreshed uv.lock.

packageRules.description: Use in-range-only strategy for all Python dependencies so pyproject.toml ranges stay the source of truth and only uv.lock moves
Group minor/patch Python dependency updates into a single PR
Group major Python dependency updates separately

Disable pip_requirements — requirements.txt is exported from uv.lock by `make sync-requirements`, not a source of truth. Only pep621 should manage Python deps to keep pyproject.toml and uv.lock in sync.
Disable pip-compile — requirements-build.txt is generated by pybuild-deps, not a source of truth.
Do not let the bot bump requires-python
Group routine GitHub Actions updates into a single PR
Keep major GitHub Actions bumps in their own PR so a breaking runtime change cannot block routine digest and security updates
Do not let the bot bump the CI Python version. Keep this rule after the grouping rules above: enabled=false is not reset by a later rule that only sets groupName.

Disable docker-compose and kubernetes managers — compose.yaml and deploy/kubernetes reference this repo's own images (localhost/execution-plane, ghcr.io/syntara-orchestration/execution-plane:latest) and env-overridable dev images (POSTGRES_IMAGE), not third-party dependencies.
Automerge digest and version refreshes of internal aap-ci Tekton catalog images
